description_zh: Waymo AV 在停止标志处停车后起步直行通过交叉口，左侧相邻车道（对向车道但同向）的重型卡车开始右转，其尾部与已停下的 AV 前部碰撞。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling north eastbound on Toland Street and came to a stop at a stop sign at the intersection with Jerrold Avenue.
To the left of the Waymo AV, a heavy truck was stopped, facing the same direction as the Waymo AV, but in the opposing lane of travel and partially within the intersection with Jerrold Avenue.
As the Waymo AV began to proceed forward from a stop, the heavy truck began making a wide right turn.
The Waymo AV came to a stop and the rear passenger side of the heavy truck made contact with the front driver side of the stationary Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 从报告提取：ego 为 Waymo AV，直行起步；NPC 卡车在左侧相邻（对向车道同向）进行右转，与 ego 碰撞，属于路口转弯冲突场景，block 用 junction_turn，position 用 adjacent，控制为 stop sign。
